parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain name.

To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: Logstore
parameters.description: The name of the SLS Logstore to which logs are delivered in real time.

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project to which logs are delivered in real time.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region where the SLS project is located.
